name: N1 (formerly Nation 1)
decision_note: Prague/San Francisco early-stage VC (Nation 1 and Nation 1 VC fund II, Luxembourg AIFs) that launched its U-Tech fund in May 2025 and co-invested in Liki24's $9m Series A in July 2025.

evidence.quote: We invest early and stay for the journey.
Our portfolio spans Europe and the US, united by one thing: global intent.
Today, we manage $60M across two funds focused on AI and healthcare.

Nation 1 GP S.à r.l and Nation 1 GP II S.à r.l. (the “GPs”), as general partner and registered alternative investment fund manager respectively of Nation 1 and Nation 1 VC fund II which are Luxembourg based alternative investment funds (“AIFs”)
Nový fond chce v nejbližší době investovat do celkem 20 ukrajinských startupů přibližně 10 milionů eur, tedy necelých 250 milionů korun.

Liki24’s $9 million Series A round was backed by a diverse group of investors, including u.ventures, TA Ventures, iClub, SID Venture Partners, MA7 Ventures, N1 Ventures, Dnipro VC, and angel investor Anton Borzov.
V České republice startuje nový investiční fond, který má pro tuzemské startupy připraveno 20 milionů eur, tedy zhruba půl miliardy korun.
Fond N1 Ventures U-Tech má za sebou svou první investici, další tři teď dokončuje.
Český venture kapitálový fond Nation 1 se přejmenoval na N1 a připravuje se na spuštění navazujícího fondu.
From Prague to Silicon Valley: Taikun’s exit to Cloudera.

analyst_notes: Nation 1 renamed itself N1 in September 2023 (Newstream 2023-09-19, e12) and now brands as N1 Ventures (n1.rocks; the CVCA-listed nation1.vc no longer responds). Offices: Prague (Národní 135/14), San Francisco, Luxembourg (n1.rocks). Fund vehicles are Luxembourg AIFs: Nation 1 (GP: Nation 1 GP S.à r.l.) and Nation 1 VC fund II (registered AIFM: Nation 1 GP II S.à r.l.) per the SFDR disclosure (e6); no LEI found in GLEIF and no Luxembourg RCS numbers found, so registry_id is null. No Czech legal entity found: ARES 'Nation1 Investment s.r.o.' (IČO 09172807) is owned by unrelated persons (Jaroslav Ton, Petr Jiříček) and is NOT this investor. Fund I: launched 2019-08-02 with EUR 20m (EIF EUR 15m), target EUR 35m (Lupa.cz e10; CVCA 2020 profile: EUR 35m); final size not re-verified. Fund II size and close date not disclosed (CzechCrunch 2023 reported plans for close to CZK 1bn). Capital = 'USD 60M across two funds' stated on n1.rocks (page undated; as_of = retrieval date). U-Tech: 'independent fund built by N1' for Ukrainian startups, launched 2025-05-28 with co-investors Pale Fire Capital, Josef Průša, Libor Winkler; plans to invest ~EUR 10m into ~20 startups (target deployment, not a confirmed fund size); first investment Respeecher seed (amount undisclosed; date = article date, investment closed on or before it). Liki24 Series A USD 9m, Vestbee 2025-07-03 (Tech.eu Funding Explorer: EUR 7.6m). Other reported but not cited: Novoflow USD 3.1m seed (Nov 2025) and Myriad AI USD 7.8m seed (Sep 2025) - sources are aggregators and conflict on N1's participation. Ticket: own site 'Typical 1st investment $100K–$1M'; earlier sources: EUR 50k-1.5m (Lupa 2019, CVCA 2020). Focus has shifted from Czech startups (Fund I) to AI/healthtech in Europe and the US; still has a Prague office and Czech partners. Not a platform (E2 not applicable): it invests its funds' managed capital directly. [revision 2026-10-25 re-audit: scope rule: both cited in-window deals are Ukrainian (Liki24, Respeecher via U-Tech), so a Czech portfolio company is now evidenced - Taikun, Prague cloud start-up whose exit to Cloudera N1 lists as a success story (own site, e13; Hedepy, the Czech online-therapy platform, is also listed as partially exited); office Národní 135/14, Prague 1. Capital re-checked: 'USD 60M across two funds' (aum, own site) kept; the U-Tech and fund I entries remain 'launch' events and are not used as activity or capital. Activity (Liki24 Series A, Vestbee 2025-07-03), type vc and ticket (USD 100k-1m typical first investment, stated) unchanged.]
